blindWork: n(H+) = 15.0 mL x 0.500 M = 7.50 mmol; n(OH-) = 2 x 35.0 mL x 0.200 M = 14.0 mmol. Excess OH- = 14.0 - 7.50 = 6.50 mmol in 50.0 mL total, giving [OH-] = 0.130 M, which corresponds most closely to the listed 0.140 M.
stem: Concentration / Molarity: If $15.0\text{~mL}$ of $0.500\text{~M}\text{~HNO}_{3}$ is mixed with $35.0\text{~mL}$ of $0.200\text{~M}\text{~Ba(OH)}_{2}$, what is the resulting $\left\lbrack \text{OH}^{-} \right\rbrack$ in the final solution?
sourceExplanation: $n\left( \text{H}^{+} \right) = 0.015 \times 0.500 = 0.0075\text{~mol}$. $n\left( \text{OH}^{-} \right) = 0.035 \times 0.200 \times 2 = 0.014\text{~mol}$. Excess $\text{OH}^{-} = 0.014 - 0.0075 = 0.0065\text{~mol}$. Total volume $= 50.0\text{~mL} = 0.050\text{~L}$. $\left\lbrack \text{OH}^{-} \right\rbrack = 0.0065/0.050 = 0.130\text{~M}$ (approx B / C check calculations).
